'''Fuel trucks''' were vehicles that delivered fuel to other vehicles, including the [[StarSpeeder 3000]]s belonging to the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency.<ref name="ST" />

At least one truck was [[Incident above Coruscant|sighted]] on Coruscant between [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> Several were stationed on a Star Tours&ndash;owned [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceport]]. When the pilot droid [[RX-24/Legends|RX-24]] returned with [[Star Tours Flight 45|ST-45]] to the spaceport shortly after accidentally participating in the [[Battle of Death Star III]] via hyperspace, he had a near-crash with one of the fuel trucks which was being driven by a red-and-white [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
The near-collision with the fuel truck appeared at the end of the [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride film.<ref name="ST" /> The registration number on the side of the fuel truck the speeder nearly crashes into is Lucasfilm's old office phone number.<ref name="A Look Back">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/kessel/f20040618/index.html|series=Kessel Mines|text=A Look Back at Star Tours}}</ref>
